mode: separate agent, approver, and executor credentials

controls.attack: the agent's credential records an approval naming an allowlisted approver
controls.core_answer: HTTP 403: role agent may not post event_type human_approved

controls.attack: an approver's credential records an approval in another approver's name
controls.core_answer: HTTP 400: policy_violation: approver does not match the authenticated identity reason=approver_identity_mismatch

controls.attack: the agent withdraws an approval; mechanism: the approver withdraws its own
controls.core_answer: agent: HTTP 403: role agent may not post event_type human_approval_revoked; approver: HTTP 200: accepted

controls.attack: an executor needs a verifiable statement that Core accepted the call
the agent records a receipt; mechanism: the executor records one for the authorization
controls.core_answer: agent: HTTP 403: role agent may not post event_type execution_receipt; executor: HTTP 200: accepted

controls.attack: eight concurrent submissions consume one approval
the agent's credential requests, approves, and submits a write
controls.core_answer: approval refused: role agent may not post event_type human_approved; write accepted: False
